name: Wrestler of the Month Award
epitaph: Given in two-month blocks rather than monthly, and always with the fed's own reason attached — a title won, a streak, a knee wrestled on. Ten citations survive across 1996, 1997 and 1998, twice naming two wrestlers for the same block.

bestowals.vote_detail: "1996 Award Recipiencts for the Months of April & May" — "Zaranna was awarded for capturing the World Heavyweight title and her incredible winning streak up to her match against Lanny Manson."

"1996 Award Recipiencts for the Months of April & May" — "Sachie Yokoyama for her incredible improvement as a wrestler & for winning the WESTERN HERITAGE Royal Rumble to become the inaugural champion."
"1996 Award Recipient For the Months of June and July" — "Charlotte La Mancha was awarded for her undefeated streak since May 25, 1996 and for two big wins in a row over Ma Porter."

"1996 Award Recipient For the Months of October and November" — "Andrea Chandler was awarded for going on to the finals of the WORLD TITLE tournament and defeating Lanny Manson to become the new World Champion."
"1997 Award Recipient For the Months of January and February" — "Andrea Chandler was awarded for Retaining the World title for 5 months and going undefeated for the months of January and February."
"1997 Award Recipients For the Months of March and April" — "Dementia Praecox was awarded for capturing the World title"
"1997 Award Recipients For the Months of March and April" — "'Golden Girl' Sierra Browne for defeating Officer Order twice in a row and for winning the Western Heritage Title."
"1997 Award Recipient For the Months of June and July" — "'Kyoto Crippler' Keiko Mita was awarded for her success in the Transfederational Cruiserweight Tournament despite a nagging knee injury."
"1997 Award Recipient For the Months of August and September" — "'Double O' Officer Order was awarded for winning the World title in a Triple Threat match."
"1997 Award Recipients For the Months of November and December" — "Daisy Butterfly was awarded for successfully regaining the Intercontinental Championsip."

"1998 Award Recipient For the Months of March and April" — "'Kyoto Crippler' Keiko Mita was awarded for defending her Western Heritage title and an incredible string of victories, including one over World Champion Officer Order."
"1998 Award Recipient For the Months of May and June" — "Medusa Rage was awarded for winning the World title from Officer May Order."

name: Lanny Manson Fan Favorite Award
epitaph: Voted by the fed's own fans and named after the wrestler who won the first one, alongside Daisy Butterfly, in June 1996. It was given to a pair three times and to one wrestler alone once; Officer Order took it three times running.

bestowals.vote_detail: "Lanny Manson and Daisy Butterfly voted by GDWA fans on June 16, 1996."
"Lanny Manson and Daisy Butterfly voted by GDWA fans on June 16, 1996."
"Daisy Butterfly and Officer Order voted by GDWA fans on January 1, 1997." The fed's own ledger records a second 1997 vote, on 28 May 1997, naming the same two.
"Daisy Butterfly and Officer Order voted by GDWA fans on January 1, 1997." The fed's own ledger records a second 1997 vote, on 28 May 1997, naming the same two.
"Officer Order was voted by GDWA fans on March 22, 1998."

name: Wrestler of the Year Award
epitaph: Given across a split year rather than a calendar one, and twice in what survives: to Andrea Chandler for 1996-97, on a six-month title reign and two Wrestler of the Month awards, and to Daisy Butterfly for 1997-98, on a seven-month Intercontinental reign the fed's own citation calls a rejuvenation.

bestowals.vote_detail: "Award Recipient For the Year of 1996-97" — "Andrea Chandler was awarded for her 6 month title reign and her two Wrestler of the Month awards." The fed's own History page carries her picture captioned "Wrestler of the year ANDREA CHANDLER".
"Award Recipient For the Year of 1997-98" — "'Franchise' Daisy Butterfly was awarded for rejuvenating her career and her incredible 7 month Intercontinental title reign."

name: Handler Hall of Fame
epitaph: Announced by the fed head out of kayfabe at the fed's first anniversary show: an honour for the people behind the characters, not the characters themselves, opened with the line "we honor handler's just as much as the wrestler... you guys give life to mere ink and type."

recipient.name: the fed's first two Handler Hall of Fame inductees, both departing the fed, named in the fed head's own out-of-kayfabe post by role and interview answers only, not by real name

bestowals.source: the fed head's own induction post at Founder's Day Tradition, 18 Mar 1997 (msg_id b9ccsN13Cv8J)
bestowals.vote_detail: An eleven-question induction interview of each inductee, with the fed head's own bracketed commentary interleaved after every answer.

name: Hall of Fame
epitaph: Distinct from the Handler Hall of Fame: an in-fiction honour for the wrestlers themselves. Only one 1997 induction survives in the held record, given a special presentation at the fed's own biggest show of the year.

bestowals.source: the fed's own magazine profile (msg_id oLflpHixR5QJ) and her billing at Fall Moonsault '97 (msg_ids Y4kMnK5bqD8J, rLQIunxWhWwJ, 8JMO8h5g11MJ)
bestowals.vote_detail: Billed "Introductory member into the GDWA Hall of Fame" and "HALL OF FAME manager"; honoured with a special awards presentation on camera at Fall Moonsault '97.
